prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a stocky dark blue fish-man warrior wearing a few large clearly shaped plates of pink and white coral armour on the chest and shoulders, a tall red fin crest on top of its head, a big fish face with large round gold eyes and a heavy underbite of small teeth, clearly visible and not covered by the crest, exactly one round spiral seashell shield on the arm on the right side of the image (toward the heroes) and a long barbed spear in the hand on the left side of the image, webbed feet. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: its fish face with large round gold eyes and the heavy underbite is readable in every cell.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, stepping forward and thrusting the barbed spear past the shield toward the heroes, the spear point on the right side of the image ahead of the body, the one shell shield on the same arm as in the idle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the shell shield on the same arm raised in front of the chest, the red crest flattened, the spear tilting back, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight clearly onto one leg, twist the torso and extend the arms and the spear far from the body. Draw only the parts and clothing named in the description, the same in every cell: no cape, cloak, scarf or extra cloth, and no slash trail, smear, motion arc or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a trident, a cape, a crown, twin blades, two shields, a fish tail instead of legs, an anglerfish lure, a spear pointing away from the heroes.
